text: Demand the published homogeneous bounce of a rotating 10-solar-mass parent. If all parent angular momentum reached the bounce, rotation would overshoot the causal limit by a factor of 6.6 times 10 to the power 26. Self-consistency leaves at most about one part in 10 to the power 27, with the treatment branches spanning roughly one order of magnitude. Under Reading 2, rotating collapse never reaches this homogeneous solution at all. What happens instead remains underived.
